query: SELECT f.record_kind AS "kind!: String", f.record_id AS "id!: String", f.position AS "position!: i64", f.epoch AS "epoch!: i64", f.router_time AS "time?: String", f.time_basis AS "time_basis!: String" FROM json_each(?) k CROSS JOIN project_feed f ON f.position = (SELECT MIN(first.position) FROM project_feed first WHERE first.record_kind = json_extract(k.value, '$[0]') AND first.record_id = json_extract(k.value, '$[1]')) ORDER BY f.record_kind, f.record_id
